verdict.rationale: Sumsub's own docs describe business verification levels with separate Company data, Company documents, and Associated parties steps, so it ships a documented KYB flow that captures related parties. Nothing in the pack shows registry lookups, explicit UBO identification, or how associated parties chain into individual KYC. Missing for 10: company registry lookups, explicit UBO identification/ownership-structure docs, documented chaining of KYB into KYC on owners, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners

citations.quote: The main change affects the all-in-one Company step which is now replaced by a few separate steps—Company data, Company documents, and Associated parties.
